subject: general
question: When did the Central Industrial Security Force come into existence in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1969**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CISF **was set up **under an Act of the Parliament **of India on **10 March 1969**.
 
• Its **strength **was **2,800**.
 
• On **15 June 1983**, CISF was **subsequently made **an **armed force of India **by another **Act of Parliament passed**.
 
• The **government raised **the sanctioned strength **from 145,000 to 180,000 personnel **in **April 2017**.
 
• The **CISF **is **governed by **the **Union Ministry of Home Affairs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CISF **is a **unique organization **in the **paramilitary forces **of India which works for **airways, seaways, **and **some of the major installations **in **India**.
 
• The **CISF plays an important role **in **Disaster Management.**
 
• The **headquarter **of CISF are in **New Delhi**.
